caseName: Galuszka v. Schwab ex rel. Schwab
caseNameFull: Galuszka v. Schwab, for and on Behalf of the Minor, Schwab

opinions.text: Appeal from Ct. App. La., 4th Cir., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the *804appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
